title: Huawei Ascend 910C
summary: Huawei's domestic AI accelerator, manufactured without access to advanced lithography.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

The Ascend 910C is Huawei's current data-centre accelerator, built on a domestically produced 7nm-class process and paired with Huawei's own interconnect and software stack. It is the main substitute for Nvidia hardware inside China after export controls restricted sales of advanced chips. Performance per chip is below the leading US parts; the system-level design compensates by scaling out.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Early commercial
Estimated window 2025–2027
Confidence label Researching
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

Buyers outside China should treat Ascend as the reference point for a parallel AI stack that will set prices in emerging markets.

What Would Change The View

  • Yield and supply volume at SMIC.
  • Software maturity against CUDA.
  • Power efficiency at rack level.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
